observations: Photo 0 shows a large floor-standing multifunction copier/printer with four paper trays stacked at the bottom.
A color test/sample print sheet with color bars and an image is resting on the top glass, suggesting a color output capability.
A control panel with a small screen and buttons is visible on the upper right of the machine.
No clearly readable brand or model plate is visible in the image as described.
A motorcycle and some other boxed equipment are visible in the background, suggesting a shop or warehouse setting.
No power cable, cords, or 'powered on' screen is visible to confirm the unit is operational.

claims.claim: A3 and A4 direct image multifunctional copier
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a copier-shaped device but no text confirming A3/A4 direct image capability.
No spec plate, display, or printed speed label visible in photo 0.
A color test sheet with color bars sits on the glass in photo 0, which is suggestive but not conclusive proof of working color output.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or may have internal faults (drum, fuser, PCB) not visible in a static photo.
risks.proof: A video of the unit powering on, displaying its home screen, and producing a live test copy.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for parts

risks.risk: Brand and exact model (which sets true speed, color capability, and market value) cannot be read from the photo.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the brand/model nameplate or control panel sticker.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced without this; identity and price tier remain unknown

risks.risk: Page/copy counter could reveal heavy prior usage lowering value.
risks.proof: A photo of the counter/usage page displayed on the control panel or printed from the menu.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged trays, toner cartridges, or internal parts not visible from this single angle.
risks.proof: Photos of open trays, toner compartment, and rear/side panels.

risks.risk: Color print quality claim unproven beyond a single static test sheet, which could be an old or pre-printed sample, not a live output of this unit.
risks.proof: A fresh color test print made in front of the camera with timestamp or live video.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the brand and model nameplate or control panel label.
Video of the machine powering on and producing a live copy/print.
Photo of the usage/page counter from the control panel.
Photos of open paper trays and toner/drum compartment.
A fresh, live color test print shown being made, not a pre-existing sample sheet.
response.reason: The item type is clear as a multifunction copier, but no brand or model is readable, and copier value varies hugely by make, model, and speed, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without a nameplate photo or working test video.
